title: Expanding Use of ActiveSG Credits to Include Sports Facilities Such As Those at Community Clubs and The Kallang
what_it_is: Expanding Use of ActiveSG Credits to Include Sports Facilities Such As Those at Community Clubs and The Kallang

sections.label: ActiveSG credits at sports facilities
sections.summary: The Government says ActiveSG credits can be used at ActiveSG and community sport facilities, ActiveSG and Active Health programmes, and over 370 school sports facilities under the Dual-Use Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The Government is committed to ensuring that public sports facilities remain accessible and affordable for all Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: ActiveSG credits can be used at all ActiveSG sports facilities, including ActiveSG’s World Aquatics Championship Arena at The Kallang, as well as community sport facilities in Our Tampines Hub and Senja-Cashew Community Club.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The credits can also be used to offset the cost of ActiveSG and Active Health programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Since November 2025, we have also expanded the use of ActiveSG credits across more than 370 school sports facilities under the Dual-Use Scheme (DUS), providing more opportunities for the public to utilise their ActiveSG credits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: SportSG will continue to explore ways to expand the use of ActiveSG credits at more public sports facilities.

sections.label: My ActiveSG+ booking system enhancement
sections.summary: SportSG is enhancing the My ActiveSG+ booking system, focusing first on user experience before expanding ActiveSG credits for People's Association facilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: Rest assured, Sport SG is working on enhancing the My ActiveSG+ booking system – first, focusing on enhancing and improving the user experience, before working on expanding the use of ActiveSG credits for People's Association facilities.
